title_en: Funko Unveils Street Fighter Pop! Figures: How the Toy Company Is Reimagining Capcom's Iconic World Warriors
summary_en: The cast of the new Street Fighter movie have been given a cutesy plastic makeover. Check out our exclusive first look at Funko's Pop! Movies: Street Fighter figures.
body_en:
As the release date for Paramount's Street Fighter movie reboot draws closer, we're getting a better look at the various toys and collectibles surrounding the film. IGN can exclusively reveal a new line of Funko Pop! figures inspired by the cast of the new movie.
Check out the slideshow gallery below for a first look at the Pop! Movies: Street Fighter line of figures:
This new series consists of five figures in total:
Each figure measures between 4 and 5 inches tall, depending on pose and hairstyle, and they're priced at $14.99 each. The figures should begin hitting store shelves today.
Previously, IGN got an exclusive first look at Hasbro's Street Fighter movie figures , so collectors will definitely have some options in the months to come.
In other Street Fighter news, Paramount recently dropped the second trailer for the reboot , one that showcases more drama between Ken and Ryu and E. Honda doing the Hundred-Hand Slap. We also learned that Chun-Li actress Callina Lang grew her thighs by 6.5 cm to match the character's muscular physique.
Jesse is a mild-mannered staff writer for IGN. Allow him to lend a machete to your intellectual thicket by following @jschedeen on BlueSky .
